payload.reason: The evidence explicitly mentions three variants of cross-validation and describes them in detail.

claims.text: The three variants of cross-validation examined are: 10-fold stratified blocked cross-validation, 10-fold not stratified blocked cross-validation, and 10-fold stratified random selection of examples.
Cross-validation is used to evaluate classifiers in static data scenarios, while sequential validation is used for time-ordered data.
The study finds that standard random selection of examples is significantly worse than blocked cross-validation for evaluating classifiers in time-ordered data scenarios.
